PDF Tools

All tools organized by category.

Most Popular#

  • PDF Text Editor (Alpha) - Edit text and images in the browser
  • Multi-Tool - Upload once, chain operations
  • Read & Annotate - PDF viewer with annotations
  • Merge - Combine multiple PDFs
  • Convert - 50+ format conversions
  • Compress - Reduce file size
  • OCR - Make scanned PDFs searchable
  • Compare - See differences between PDFs
  • Redact - Remove sensitive content

Security#

  • Add/Remove Password
  • Change Permissions
  • Sign - Handwritten signatures
  • Certificate Sign - Digital signatures
  • Validate Signature
  • Add Watermark
  • Sanitize PDF
  • Redact

Page Operations#

  • Split PDF
  • Merge PDFs
  • Rotate Pages
  • Extract Pages
  • Reorganize Pages
  • Add Page Numbers
  • Remove Pages/Blank Pages

Detailed Guide: Redaction

Convert#

To PDF: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Images, HTML, Markdown, Email, and more

From PDF: Word, PowerPoint, Text, Images, CSV, HTML, XML, PDF/A, and more

Content & Editing#

  • Add/Extract Images
  • Add Stamp
  • Edit Metadata
  • Remove Annotations
  • Replace Colors
  • Get PDF Info

Advanced Tools#

  • Overlay PDFs
  • Booklet Imposition
  • Multi-Page Layout
  • Scale Pages
  • Auto Rename
  • Show JavaScript
  • Scanner Effect

Quick Tool Finder#

I want to...

  • Reduce file size → Compress
  • Make searchable → OCR
  • Combine files → Merge
  • Split into parts → Split
  • Convert format → Convert
  • Add signature → Sign or Certificate Sign
  • Remove content → Redact or Sanitize
  • Edit pages → Reorganize Pages or Multi-Tool
  • Automate workflow → Automate
